text:
Cassidy Park: morning all — excited to start! laptop arrived but MDM enrollment is asking for an enrollment code. also need VPN and repo access. who should I ping? bonus: desk plant recs appreciated :) :seedling:

Asha Mehta: welcome Cassidy!! :tada: quick favor — DM your pronouns + timezone and i'll add you to the right onboarding invites. snake plant or pothos are good starter plants.

Liam O'Connor: hey @Cassidy Park — i'm your onboarding buddy. i'll help with perms and the quickstart. plan: 1) enroll MDM, 2) add SSH key (ed25519), 3) Okta MFA, 4) confirm repo access. ping me when you're ready for a 20m pairing.

Cassidy Park: thanks Liam. for SSH key, do i generate locally or is there a portal option?

Jin Park: generate locally. recommended: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "cassidy@redwood"``` then paste ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub into the dev portal -> Access -> SSH Keys. shout if you hit a permissions error.

Cassidy Park: MDM says "Enrollment code: required" — where do i get that?

MDM-Bot: Hi Cassidy — enrollment codes are issued by IT. If you received a physical kit check the sticky label. Otherwise request a one-time code from IT or ask @Jin Park to generate one-time code.

Jin Park: created a one-time code and sent via DM. let me know if it times out and i'll regenerate.

Evan Ng: note for VPN use the "redwood-split" profile. docs: https://intranet.redwood/it/vpn. after MDM + Okta the VPN cert should provision automatically.

Cassidy Park: enrolled with the code and added SSH key. i can see the infra repo now. thanks everyone! also bought a little pothos for my desk :) :raised_hands:
